title: Agent tool manifest
description: One tool contract. A manifest names a single action, its typed inputs and outputs, its side effect, the errors it reports, and the credentials it needs by name.

snake_case.description: Lowercase snake_case name. A credential or error code, never a secret value.

object_schema.description: A JSON Schema object for a tool payload. Combinators belong in prose and in the server, not in the published schema.

name.description: Fully qualified tool name <namespace>.<tool>. Each segment is lowercase snake_case. Example: browser.handoff.

version.description: Semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. A breaking input or output change requires a new MAJOR.

when_to_use.description: When an agent should call this tool.

side_effects.description: What the call changes. A non-empty string. Read-only tools say "None." explicitly.

errors.description: Errors this tool reports. An empty list is allowed and must be written explicitly. Each code is lowercase snake_case and unique within the manifest.

auth_needed.description: Credential or session names this tool relies on. Names only, never values. An empty list is allowed and must be written explicitly.
